tei:div.tei:p: (843)klong chen snying thig gi bka' srung gsol mchod shin tu bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ skad cig dran rdzogs rang mdun thod sgyed stong*/ dum gcig ka pa la yi snod nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs sbyor sgrol rdzas/ spro bsdus 'khrul gyi rgyal kun gsang gsum bcud/ spyan drangs gtor ma'i rdzas dang dbyer med gyur/ dngos 'jin dri ma'i ma sbag mchod gtor rdzas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dpal yon rab ldan pas/ mchog (844)gsum rtsa gsum bka' srung chos skyong spyi/ khyad par sngags srung e ka tsa ṭi dang*/ dpal mgon ma ning mgon po pho rgyud tshogs/ sgrol ging rdo rje legs pa mched 'khor bcas/ gza' bdud chen po gdong mo sde brgyad 'khor/ dur khrod lha mo ming sring brgyad po dang*/ tshe ring mched lnga g.yu sgron brten mar bcas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas/ (845)(846)mchod cing bstod do bskong ngo mnga' gsol lo/ dgyes shing tshim par mjad nas nyams chags bshags/ rab 'byams phrin las gang bcol 'grub pa dang*/ 'phral phug yongs dge sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pa 'di yang pad+ma chos 'phel gyi ngor/ rdo blas smras pa yongs su dge bar gyur cig// /
